Since we don't have direct access to the secret values via the `list_secrets` tool, I will check the documentation or configuration files related to the deployment manifest to ensure that the production credentials are properly specified there.

If you can provide more details about where the production credentials should be stored or how they are referenced in the deployment process, we could use that information to identify any issues. Alternatively, if you have access to the relevant part of the deployment manifest, please share it so I can assist further.
